newsitem.title: USA: Travelers gets OK for $1 billion stock buyback; stock jumps.
newsitem.headline: Travelers gets OK for $1 billion stock buyback; stock jumps.

text.p: Travelers Group Inc., the giant insurance and financial services company, said Wednesday its board of directors authorised the company to buy back up to $1 billion of its common shares.
Following the news, Travelers' stock jumped $2.125 to $53.50 on the New York Stock Exchange.

The stock buyback comes one day after the New York-based firm reported that its profits rose 6 percent in the fourth quarter and jumped 27 percent for the full year, propelled by the strong performances of its brokerage and insurance divisions.
Travelers also announced that its board voted to keep its quarterly dividend at 15 cents a share, on a post-split basis. In late October, it declared a 4-for-3 stock split.
The company said it repurchased 17.3 million common shares last year under the board's $600 million authorisation, which was announced last March.
